scripts.check:quality: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run build
scripts.create:pages:preview: wrangler pages project create portfolio-games-preview --production-branch main --force
scripts.deploy:web:production: wrangler pages deploy apps/web/dist --project-name portfolio-games-preview --branch main
scripts.deploy:web:preview: wrangler pages deploy apps/web/dist --project-name portfolio-games-preview --branch preview
scripts.deploy:web:react-preview: wrangler pages deploy apps/web/dist --project-name portfolio-games-preview --branch react-preview
scripts.test: npm run build && node --experimental-strip-types --test apps/web/test/*.test.mjs && node --test packages/contracts/test/*.test.mjs packages/connect-four/test/*.test.mjs packages/reversi/test/*.test.mjs apps/worker/test/*.test.mjs
